description: Step 5 Preview Spark with immutable checkpoint files and an ARM64 runtime. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: GPU memory utilization 0.85 beside the 20e9-byte KV pool, 0xSero's scripts/launch.sh defaults at 662949a6 (lines 41 and 45). The earlier 0.806230 came from an offline startup-budget fit (#1702), not from a hardware run. The declared peak is an estimate until the run measures it. Requires exactly 4 Sparks; not runnable on the current two-Spark fleet. Reproduces 0xSero's K4 expert/K8 hybrid-body image and MTP2 launch. Upstream reports 26-30 tokens/s on four Sparks; not measured here.
title: Step 5 Preview Spark vLLM 4 Sparks
